message: The other night, I realized our smoke alarm was beeping like it was auditioning for a Broadway show. Instead of letting it stress me out, I turned it into a little family event! We grabbed some snacks and made a game out of checking the alarms together. Turns out, keeping our home safe can be a cozy bonding moment. Plus, we now have a plan for what to do in case of an emergency. Who knew fire safety could be a fun family affair? 🔍 How do you make safety a little less serious?
